FACT_ID: sec12-R01 | anchor: A01
Every drug hits every body differently each time, and small doses still dull driving judgment [A01].
Why it matters: group drug-variance; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec12-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec12-R02 | anchor: A01
Combinations multiply harm, and alcohol mixes can sicken or kill [A01].
Why it matters: group mixing; difficulty low; prereq sec12-F01; confusables sec12-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec12-R03 | anchor: A01
Alcohol strikes judgment first and self-knowledge last, then degrades every driving sense [A01].
Why it matters: group alcohol-path; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec12-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec12-R04 | anchor: A01
Beer, wine, and cocktail servings equalize by alcohol amount, not by glass [A01].
Why it matters: group equivalence; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec12-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec12-R05 | anchor: A02
Point-oh-five to point-oh-eight convicts to hundreds in fines, months in jail, or both [A02].
Why it matters: group low-bac; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec12-F05 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec12-R06 | anchor: A02
Keys in hand equal consent given, refusals revoke automatically, and point-oh-eight fails the license [A02].
Why it matters: group consent; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec12-F06 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec12-R07 | anchor: A02
Officer eyes convict below limits and without tests, and DUI spans drugs, drink, or both [A02].
Why it matters: group evidence; difficulty medium; prereq sec12-F06; confusables sec12-F07 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec12-R08 | anchor: A02
Conviction notices suspend thirty days, six months, then a year [A02].
Why it matters: group suspension-ladder; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec12-F08 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec12-R09 | anchor: A02
DUI jail-plus-fine ladders climb from misdemeanor days to felony decade-years [A02].
Why it matters: group dui-ladder; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec12-F09 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec12-R10 | anchor: A03
DUI revocations run half-years, years, and double-years by prior count [A03].
Why it matters: group revocation-ladder; difficulty medium; prereq sec12-F09; confusables sec12-F10 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec12-R11 | anchor: A03
Arrests bill lawyers, rides, courts, programs, interlocks, insurers, and futures [A03].
Why it matters: group costs; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec12-F11 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec12-R12 | anchor: A03
Prescriptions, pot, and street drugs each out-impair in their own way with labels and doctors as guides [A03].
Why it matters: group other-drugs; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec12-F12 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec12-R13 | anchor: A04
Any youth alcohol, any youth drug influence, or their blend all break zero tolerance [A04].
Why it matters: group zero-tolerance; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec12-F13 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec12-R14 | anchor: A04
Youth fines swap with service and treatment, and under-eighteen offenses reach the licensing agency [A04].
Why it matters: group youth-fines; difficulty low; prereq sec12-F13; confusables sec12-F14 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0067]
